intro: Publishing version {version} makes it the version new learners start on. Here is who that affects.

noLive: Nobody yet: no version is live.
midway: In the middle of a changed lesson
midwayValue: {count, plural, one {# enrolled learner is} two {# enrolled learners are} other {# enrolled learners are}} part-way through a lesson this version changes or removes. They keep the old lesson.
changes: {count, plural, one {# change} two {# changes} other {# changes}} from the live version
noChanges: The content is the same as the live version.
fixed: {count, plural, one {Fixes # check} two {Fixes # checks} other {Fixes # checks}} marked as faulty in the live version:
carried.title: Faulty checks carried over
carried.body: {count, plural, one {# check is} two {# checks are} other {# checks are}} marked faulty in the live version and unchanged here. Fix them first, or mark them faulty again after publishing.
nobodyMoves: Nobody is moved. Learners already enrolled keep the version they started, including any fix in this one.
